The Intake

Five gentle steps. Nothing more is asked of you.

Answer at your own pace. Your answers shape a prayer, an affirmation, or a story made for this moment — and if you wish, a real person to pray alongside you.

Step 1 of 5

What brings you here today?

Please reach out right now — you matter, and help is free.

If you may harm yourself or you are in danger, please contact a helpline before anything else. In the United States, call or text 988. In an emergency, call 911. The full list is here. You may continue the intake whenever you are ready — there is no hurry, and no judgment here.

Which tradition speaks to you?

How would you like to receive it?

Your room is ready

Would you like us to stay in touch?

Entirely optional. Choose either, both, or neither — your prayer above is already yours.

The Brain — A Library of Light

Every tradition, resting in its own niche.

The Brain gathers prayers, affirmations, teachings and stories from the world's great faiths and teachers. It learns, with care, which words meet which hearts — so the prayer it offers you grows wiser the more it is used, while never forgetting that some words must simply be held by a human being. Search it freely. It is yours.

The Canon & The Teachers

Built from the best of every house of faith.

The Great Books

The Psalms and the Bible · The Qur'an · The Bhagavad Gita and the Upanishads · The Dhammapada · The Guru Granth Sahib · The Tao Te Ching · The Ifá corpus of verses and stories · The sayings and stories carried by Indigenous elders and by the Baháʼí writings.

The Teachers

Howard Thurman · Thomas Merton · Abraham Joshua Heschel · Thich Nhat Hanh · Rumi — and, for universal law and prosperity teaching, Neville Goddard and Reverend Ike, whose central word endures: change your conception of yourself, and you change your world.

The Seven Principles of Universal Law

Mentalism

All begins in mind. The prayer first changes the one who prays.

Correspondence

As within, so without. Inner order invites outer order.

Vibration

Nothing rests; everything moves. Gratitude lifts the frequency of a day.

Polarity

Every sorrow carries its opposite within reach — grief is love with nowhere yet to go.

Rhythm

Seasons turn. What is winter now is not winter forever.

Cause & Effect

Every kind word is a seed. Prayer is planting, done deliberately.

Gender — the Seventh

Within every heart: the strength to act, and the tenderness to receive. A whole prayer uses both.

The Human Prayer Portal

Real people. Real prayer. For you.

Some moments should not be met by a machine. In the full service, trained volunteer prayer partners — from many traditions — will read every request and pray over it by name, or in anonymity, exactly as you choose. This will always be free.

Pray for someone

Prayer partners commit to a small, faithful rhythm: a few requests each week, prayed over with care, in their own tradition, at their own altar, kitchen table, or quiet corner.

  • Requests arrive without surnames or addresses — dignity is protected
  • You pray in your own tradition, always
  • One gentle notification per request, never a flood

Staying Close, Gently

Notifications that behave like a friend, not an alarm.

“Your prayer is ready”

By push or email, per request — the moment your tailored prayer is prepared. Only when you have asked for one.

“Someone has prayed for you”

In the full service, when a prayer partner has held your request, you are told — with their first name, or simply, “a friend.”

One daily prayer

A single prayer each morning, in your tradition, chosen by the Brain for your season. Silence it any day, with one tap.

How the Brain learns — and what it never does

The system learns in aggregate (in aggregate: from patterns across many people, never by exposing one person's prayer to another). It notices which prayers bring people back, which affirmations are carried longest, and which stories comfort which seasons — then ranks its niches accordingly, so the library improves at scale. Human prayer partners review and correct its tone. It never sells data, never profiles a soul for advertising, and never lets an algorithm sit where a crisis needs a human voice — the safety branch always comes first.

Membership — A Charitable Trust

Congregations & Communities

A partner tier for churches, mosques, temples, sanghas, and community groups: a shared prayer wall, partner training, and a library in your tradition. Terms are set with each community, plainly and in writing.

The Privacy Promise

What is whispered here stays here.

Never sold

Prayer data is never sold, shared, or used for advertising. Not in part, not in aggregate-for-sale, not ever.

Yours to delete

Ask, and your prayers, requests, and contact details are deleted — completely, and confirmed to you.

Only what is needed

The intake asks five gentle questions and nothing more. Data is gathered to serve the prayer, never to harvest the person.
